stories.title: Distance Calculation Contract and Data Schema
stories.description: Define input/output contract for distance calculation including origin/destination coordinates, units (miles/km), and response fields (distance, duration, source). Ensure compatibility with existing Google Routes response structure.

stories.title: Core Distance Calculation Logic
stories.description: Implement backend service to compute distance and travel duration using coordinates, leveraging existing Google Routes integration logic and fallback handling for missing or invalid coordinates.

stories.title: Service Integration with Provider and Trial Flows
stories.description: Integrate distance calculation into provider search and clinical trial workflows so results include computed distance from user location to provider or trial site.

stories.title: Distance Calculation API Exposure
stories.description: Expose distance calculation through internal service interface or API layer for reuse by facades and tool router, ensuring consistent invocation and error handling.

stories.title: Distance Calculation Tests and Edge Case Validation
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests validating correct distance and duration outputs, handling of invalid coordinates, zero-distance cases, and API failure fallback behavior.
